population: Six previously inspected recordings; development/regression, not held-out validation
reference_policy: Reuse each original V24 paired reference window and all seven fixed timing shifts; no offset selection and no reference input to inference
implementation_parameters: Fix from physical units and synthetic counterexamples before running each candidate; record all subsequent development revisions

adoption_gate.interpretation: Choose only a stage that improves accuracy and full-reference success without material coverage losses; otherwise keep V24 default and expose V25 as experimental only

integrity: all three pixel processing steps preserved

missing HR not held or interpolated
same 309 planned windows in all six recordings
legacy flags reproduce frozen V24 core outputs
